notes: These recipes share material and source-space light positions, not calibrated brightness units.
Qt mesh content must be imported from the original OBJ hierarchy.
Current four Hero looks require a light/dark/mixed screen-space alpha-edge compositor; port silhouette-composite.js shader to Qt Quick rather than assuming default QML materials match.
Original PlayStation face-button glyphs are two-triangle texture decals placed on source geometry.

three.name: Environment Solid
three.description: Echte Modellfarben und eine neutrale HDR-Umgebung; deckende Flächen, keine Szenenlampen.

qt.modelSource: original OBJ meshes and manifest color
qt.positionUnit: Three world units, after normalization to 4.05

depthOcclusion.occludedHints: optional dashed GreaterDepth outline; needs native Qt verification

stickPolicy.click: L3/R3 pressed state; never infer click from axes

calibrationNotes: Qt Quick 3D PointLight brightness and attenuation units are not numerically identical to Three.js intensity/decay.
Map mesh colors with color-management and verify gamma and tone mapping against photographed reference panels.
Transparency compositing, depth sorting and BRDF response differ; render both engines to golden images before visual parity claims.
Qt Light probe/ambient approximation and roughness response may require calibration, never assert pixel identity.
